PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: Look at Bruno: every square he could still use shares a row or column with row 6, column 1. So nobody else can stand at row 6, column 1, or Bruno would have nowhere to go. Dahlia's clue ("Someone else in her area was on a raft.") needs the person on a raft in Dahlia's area on a square that does not share her row or column; that rules out squares for Dahlia. Look at Dahlia: every square she could still use shares a row or column with row 4, column 6. So nobody else can stand at row 4, column 6, or Dahlia would have nowhere to go. The same kind of reasoning rules out a few more squares. So Grant (G) must be at row 7, column 5. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: Bruno is now the only person who can still go in column 2. So Bruno (B) must be at row 6, column 2. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: With the rows and columns of Grant and Bruno crossed out, only one square is left for Angus that fits his clue ("He was beside the box."). So Angus (A) must be at row 8, column 3. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: Dahlia's clue ("Someone else in her area was on a raft.") needs the person on a raft in Dahlia's area on a square that does not share her row or column; that rules out squares for Dahlia. So Dahlia (D) must be at row 5, column 6. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: Clara's own clue ("She was in the Hot Tub or the Frozen Lake. She was exactly three rows north of Dahlia.") rules out more squares. So Clara (C) must be at row 2, column 1. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: Fergus's clue ("Someone else in his area was in a car.") needs the person in a car in Fergus's area on a square that does not share his row or column; that rules out squares for Fergus. The murderer must be in Violet's area without sharing her row or column; that rules out squares for Violet. Where can the person on a raft in Dahlia's area stand? Only at row 4, column 8, so whoever it is stands there: nobody else can use row 4 or column 8. So Fergus (F) must be at row 1, column 4. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_7_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Edith that fits her clue ("She was not in a car."). So Edith (E) must be at row 4, column 8. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_8_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Violet. So Violet (the victim) must be at row 3, column 7. Cross out her row and column. Fergus is the only person in the Car Park with Violet, so Fergus is the murderer!

CHARACTERS.char_quote_en_2: She was in the Hot Tub or the Frozen Lake. She was exactly three rows north of Dahlia.
CHARACTERS.char_quote_en_3: Someone else in her area was on a raft. She was in the Frozen Lake, but not beside the water.
CHARACTERS.char_quote_en_4: She was not in a car.
CHARACTERS.char_quote_en_5: Someone else in his area was in a car. He was north of Violet.
CHARACTERS.char_quote_en_7: The Victim. She was alone with the murderer.
